mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeded 6.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand contraction that depresses corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS declined for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), supply chain bottlenecks ease, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeded 105.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increased for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeded 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates contraction in both consumer and business activity, depressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and INDPRO declined for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of ultra-low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the central bank's highly accommodative stance supports risk asset performance, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS was below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
